title: Filipe Luís’ praise for Monaco youngster makes headlines
seoTitle: Filipe Luís' praise for Monaco youngster makes headlines
subtitle: Brazilian manager highlights midfielder Lamine Camara's talent at the helm of the French club
excerpt: Find out why manager Filipe Luís drew attention by praising youngster Lamine Camara, Monaco's standout player at the start of their European campaign.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Manager Filipe Luís has drawn attention at the helm of Monaco due to his enchantment with young Senegalese midfielder Lamine Camara. The former Flamengo manager has spared no praise for the 22-year-old athlete, classifying him as a rare gem in modern football after standout performances in Europe.

The impact of the start of the European journey

Lamine Camara's strong performances under the Brazilian manager began to resonate after key matches, including a friendly against Liverpool and the French League opener. The player's secure display and intense movement in midfield left the manager fascinated during the Principality team's fixtures.

Strong statements about Lamine Camara's talent

In press conferences and statements to broadcasters, the manager stated that, in his two-decade career in professional football, he had never witnessed a youngster with such technical maturity. The head coach even defined the defensive midfielder as one of the best midfielders in the world, highlighting his ability to manage the pitch and his above-average concentration.

Tactical performance and exemplary mentality

The midfielder has stood out for his defensive behavior and exemplary tactical posture in the Conference League playoffs and other competitions. The manager emphasized the athlete's team-first character, highlighting his constant willingness to sacrifice himself for the team and his hard-working mentality.

Need for reinforcements and the international market

Camara's rapid adaptation to the coaching staff's work also occurred against a backdrop of squad changes at Monaco, which lost options in the sector and saw attempts to sign players like Brazilian Evertton Araújo vetoed by Flamengo. The Senegalese's strong performances have put the player on the radar of major English football powerhouses, generating high market expectations for the French club.

With information from LANCE!.
